new_value: Fixed the routing.rs:949 path[path.len()-2] underflow panic on empty stored route paths, two layers: (1) rust/lichen-rpl/src/table.rs add_target_route rejects empty paths ('path.is_empty() || path.len() > MAX_ROUTE_HOPS'), closing add_route/add_prefix_route/RouteEntry::refresh admission of empty paths; (2) rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs assemble_path_checked returns Ok(None) for an empty assembled chain — target==root yields an empty chain via assemble_path_from's base case, and rebuilt_routes inserts it directly (routes.routes.insert), bypassing the table guard. Tests: routing_table_rejects_empty_paths + dao_for_root_self_installs_no_empty_route (the latter proven non-vacuous: with the chain.is_empty() guard removed it panics, confirming the target==root/parent!=root bypass reaches the bug). 3x codereview delegated to reviewer model (kimi-k3): correctness found the rebuilt_routes bypass (fixed), security PASS, edge-cases PASS. Two pre-existing unrelated failures documented, not caused by this change: gateway CoapEncode (comment on l1qw.16) and lichen-node announce-relay test (new bead hr8t). Committed in 4ee803d70d.
